papers.title: BioSync: Transformer-Based Cross-Modal Fusion for a Multimodal Physiological Digital Biomarker
papers.reason: The evaluation uses only synthetic cohorts and does not model human executive-function processes, so it fails the biological-population hard filter.

papers.title: Automated detection of Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment from EEG signals using astrophysics-inspired features and hybrid feature selection
papers.reason: The paper directly applies EEG-derived features to distinguish Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment, making it a strong clinical digital-biomarker match.

papers.title: Assessment of visual and cognitive function among patients with Stargardt Disease
papers.reason: The study uses MoCA and verbal-learning assessments in a clinical population but does not specifically investigate executive function or computational biomarkers.

papers.title: Factors associated with sleep state misperception in patients with obstructive sleep apnea: a cross-sectional study
papers.reason: The study relates sleep misperception to general cognitive screening and subjective cognitive decline, but executive-function mechanisms are not a central outcome.

papers.title: Altered alpha-band regulation during naturalistic theory of mind processing in autistic children.
papers.reason: The EEG findings link alpha-band modulation to internal attentional regulation in autistic and typically developing children, although the principal construct is social cognition rather than executive function.

papers.title: Intermittent Theta Burst Stimulation Combined with Cognitive Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Protocol for an 18-Week Randomised, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Feasibility Pilot Study (The iCog.X Boost Trial)
papers.reason: The protocol targets left-DLPFC plasticity in mild cognitive impairment using cognitive training, iTBS, EEG, and TMS measures, but it does not yet report mechanistic findings.

papers.title: Neurocognitive Changes and Cerebral Blood Flow in Patients with Symptomatic Carotid Artery Stenosis before and after Carotid Endarterectomy
papers.reason: The paper associates postoperative cerebral blood-flow changes with broad MoCA improvement, but it does not isolate executive-function processes or develop a cognitive model.

papers.title: Association of vitamin E intake and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels with cognitive function in elderly residing at the Budi Mulia Tresna Werdha nursing home, East DKI Jakarta
papers.reason: This is a general MoCA-based study of nutritional and oxidative-stress correlates with no specific analysis of executive function or digital assessment.

papers.title: Upstream Tablet-Based Screening for Possible Dementia or Cognitive Impairment in Unhoused Older Adults
papers.reason: The study evaluates implementation of tablet-based cognitive-impairment screening in a vulnerable population, but it uses a conventional MoCA rather than task-derived executive-function biomarkers.

papers.title: Understanding never events: developing an ecologically valid behavioral test for left-right confusion during surgery
papers.reason: The novel behavioral paradigm measures context-sensitive errors and processing speed under realistic surgical demands, but left-right discrimination is only indirectly related to executive control.

papers.title: Maturational trajectories of neurophysiological indices of inhibitory control in typically developing children
papers.reason: The study directly characterizes developmental behavioral, ERP, and time-frequency EEG signatures of attention and inhibitory control during a Go/NoGo task.

papers.title: Validity of The Brief Virtual Reality Satisfaction Questionnaire in Elderly: Correlation of Cognitive Function with Virtual Reality Satisfaction
papers.reason: The paper examines whether general MoCA scores correlate with satisfaction with a VR exergame rather than assessing or modelling executive function.
